items.title: 2.8.2 Periodic table ke anasir ki darja-bandi (classification) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.8.2, printed pages 39-40.

blocks.text: Main-group ya numainda (representative) anasir sab ki valence shell configurations ns(a) np(b) hain, a aur b ke kisi intikhab ke saath: un ka bairooni s ya p subshell bhar raha hai. d block transition anasir mein d subshell bhar raha hai, aur f block transition anasir, ya inner transition anasir, mein f subshell. Anasir mein aage barhte hue bharne ki tarteeb ka ek muqarrar pattern hai, jis se building-up tarteeb likhi ja sakti hai: pehle period mein 1s subshell bharta hai; doosre mein 2s aur phir, period ke saath, 2p; teesre mein 3s aur 3p; chauthe mein 4s, phir 3d, phir 4p. Table ke khaake mein ns ilaqa, np ilaqa, (n - 1)d ilaqa aur (n - 2)f ilaqa nishan-zada hain. Anasir ki metals, non-metals, representative aur transition anasir, periods, groups aur blocks mein darja-bandi electronic configuration aur valence electrons par mabni hai, to har category ki kimiyai khusoosiyat is se parkhi ja sakti hain.

blocks.alt: Periodic table jis ke har khane mein bharne wala subshell likha hai: neele s block mein 1s se 7s, surkh p block mein 2p se 7p, hare d block mein 3d se 6d, aur naranji f block ki qataron mein 4f aur 5f. Note kehta hai s block ns, p block np, d block (n-1)d aur f block (n-2)f bharta hai.
blocks.caption: Periodic table jis mein s, p, d aur f blocks dikhaye gaye hain (Figure 2.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
Bharne wale subshell ke mutabiq blocks
rows: Groups 13 se 18 (s block ke saath main-group)

blocks.prompt: Ek unsur ki configuration 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p6 3d10 4s2 4p6 4d10 5s2 5p5 hai. Us ka block, group aur period batayein aur use pehchanein. 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p6 3d5 4s1 kis block ka hai?
blocks.explanation: Bairooni electrons 5s2 5p5 paanchwein shell mein saat valence electrons hain: p block, group 17, period 5, to iodine. Doosri configuration 3d subshell bhar rahi hai, to yeh d block transition unsur hai (chromium, Z = 24).

items: Representative anasir ns aur np bharte hain; transition anasir (n - 1)d; inner transition anasir (n - 2)f. Building-up tarteeb table ke period ba period chalti hai: 1s; 2s 2p; 3s 3p; 4s 3d 4p.
